user_story: As a user, I want to create a task with only a title and no optional fields so that minimal input is sufficient.

positive.title: Create a task with a valid title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid title in the title field.
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the entered title.

negative.title: Attempt to create a task without a title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
negative.expected_result: Task creation fails with an error message indicating the title is required.

edge.title: Create a task with a very long title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a very long title exceeding typical limits in the title field.
edge.expected_result: Task is created successfully if the system supports long titles; otherwise, it shows a validation error.
